plan: runie parity sweep: pi-agent-core (core) + grok-build pager (TUI)
objective: Close every parity gap so runie-core matches pi-agent-core behavior 1:1 and runie-tui matches the grok-build pager's user-visible surface for all runie-core-driven features, on a clean actors-ssot events-based async architecture.
completionCriterion: All parity steps marked done; cargo check/test green on the workspace; the parity harness (task p19) replays pi's exact event sequences and compares runie-tui snapshots against the recorded grok casts with zero diffs; lint-check clean.
